text: Ordered Philips Ultra Definition 3.5W BA11 LED Filament, E12 candelabra, explicitly TRIAC-dimmable, 300lm 2700K (3-pack) to retest with — see hardware.md 'LED dimmer compatibility bleeder' for the flicker/cutoff findings from the previous bulb. Bleeder resistor (bleeder-resistor key) should be installed alongside before retesting, since low-wattage filament LEDs are exactly the load type most prone to TRIAC holding-current dropout even when TRIAC-rated.
